bio.text: Dan Zumbach, a Republican, represents District 34 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Zumbach as serving a fourth term and as a farmer.
The biography says Zumbach served on the West Delaware School Board and the Delaware County Fair Board, and graduated from West Delaware High School.
It says Zumbach was born in 1960 in Monticello and was raised and lives near Ryan.
